Why Atelier de Sevres?

The institution hosts events, exhibitions, and virtual information sessions, ensuring a rich and stimulating experience.

The institution's alumni and industry connections provide support and opportunities for graduates as they navigate their professional journeys. Atelier de Sèvres has an impressive track record for consistently achieving admissions to prestigious institutions such as Beaux-Arts de Paris, Gobelins, and Central Saint Martins in London.

Student Life

Atelier de Sèvres offers a vibrant and dynamic campus life. Students can participate in exhibitions and events to showcase their work. Students also engage in collaborative projects, and workshops, and participate in French and international festivals.

Atelier de Sèvres attracts a diverse student body across the globe, fostering a dynamic and multicultural learning environment. The institution also hosts guest lectures and study trips, providing students with various perspectives.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Although Atelier de Sevres does not provide on-campus housing, the institution offers guidance in finding suitable accommodation options in Paris.

Atelier de Sevres recommends the International University dorms close to the campus for international students.
